rationale: The claim permits only a bounded comparison: steering may be described as better supported relative to alternatives weakened by evidence robust to sensitivity testing and independent rating. This matches the matrix’s comparative signal and does not establish intent, identify an actor, or prove steering occurred.
signal_basis:
The observable is the filled matrix: a comparative pattern showing which hypotheses accumulate inconsistent items, which items discriminate, and which conclusions shift under the sensitivity test. It is not any single document.

A second signal is rater disagreement and sensitivity. Rows where the two raters differ, or where removing one item changes the surviving set, mark where the comparison is fragile.
